purpose: v9.1 pilot: same rig co-generation recipe with (a) rig flow loss weight raised 1->4 and (b) a bone-length preservation loss (weight 5) on the recovered clean rig against the sample's ground-truth bone lengths. Targets the 10k pilot's loose rig (bone error 10-19%, on-figure .54-.79) and asks whether forcing rig accuracy pulls prompt-specific motion signature above chance on the validated retrieval metric (real ceiling top-1 59% / top-5 89%, chance 2.7%/13.5%; the v9.0 pilot scored at chance). Matched control: the v9.0 10k pilot itself (single variable pair: rig-side loss strengths). Single seed.

frozen_model.backbone: full spatiotemporal DiT with signed local temporal and spatial 3D RoPE
frozen_model.teacher_forcing: clean ground-truth history during training; generated history during rollout

validation.claim_limit: Single-seed combined-treatment run; attribution of any gain to individual components rests on the matched 2k pilots, not on this run.
